concurrent-http-fetch.name: Concurrent HTTP Fetch (Loop node)
concurrent-http-fetch.author: DeskStride
concurrent-http-fetch.description: Demonstrates the Loop node's Concurrency field: fetches several public GitHub user profiles with up to 3 requests in flight at once instead of one at a time. Needs internet access.

hello-variables.name: Variables & Conditions
hello-variables.author: DeskStride
hello-variables.description: Shows globals/vars/inputs interpolation and an expression-based Condition branch. Fully offline and safe to run.

sqlite-database-basics.name: Database Basics (SQLite create/insert/query)
sqlite-database-basics.author: DeskStride
sqlite-database-basics.description: Creates a local SQLite table, seeds it with rows from a loop, queries it back with a parameterized WHERE clause, and writes a summary. Fully offline and safe to run repeatedly.

wikipedia-search.name: Wikipedia Search
wikipedia-search.author: DeskStride
wikipedia-search.description: Opens Wikipedia, searches for "automation", opens the article and reads its title. A short browser-automation demo. Needs internet access.
